Main.title: I AM OREST MUZYKA
Main.text2: I stand in the place where design and code intersect

Abaut.content1: I'm a creative and savvy front-end developer with over a year of experience in creating cutting-edge web interfaces. I systematically hone my skills by mastering new technologies, frameworks, and programming languages. I am convinced that advancement in IT is a constant journey, so I regularly refresh my knowledge and try new approaches to development. I like working in a team where exchange of opinions and constructive conversation are encouraged. I am always ready to compromise and look for solutions that improve the quality of the product and promote effective interaction. I am open to new challenges and changes, as they provide an opportunity to grow professionally. My goal is to develop fast, user-friendly and visually appealing interfaces that make the user experience pleasant and intuitive.
Abaut.content2: I actively work on the realization of both my own ideas and commissioned projects for various clients. I have ready-made works in my arsenal that clearly demonstrate my skills and vision of the development process. When mastering new technologies, I focus on increasing the functionality of projects, making them more complex and innovative. In each new project, I use technical solutions that I have not dealt with before, which gives me the opportunity to constantly hone my professional skills. My main task is to create high-quality, comfortable, and efficient solutions that meet the requirements of both users and customers. I try to make development not only useful but also fun, while ensuring excellent quality and maximum performance of the final product.
Abaut.content3: I've been programming for over two years, including over a year in web development, specializing in front-end. I study and use the following technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, as well as frameworks and libraries, including React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js. I have basic knowledge of writing tests for components. Ukrainian is my mother tongue, I speak Polish at B1 level and English at A2 level, and I am constantly improving my language skills. I actively expand my knowledge and apply modern technologies to create high-quality and productive web solutions.

Works.SubtitleSait1: The site for lovers to improve relationships
Works.SubtitleSait3: My first job for a client
Works.FrameworkContent: Project is built on the stack:
Works.Content1: This is my own site, which was created with people in long distance relationships in mind, and who lack attention or things to do together, so this site solves most of those problems. It's a site designed for long distance couples, but it's also great for those who want to know about their partner, their mood, what they're doing, and things like that. The main goal of the project is to help couples who don't have a lot of time to ask about their partner's health or what they are doing, instead you can go to the site and see what your partner is doing at the moment, what they want to do tonight, it will give you the opportunity to hear your partner's desires and make them come true.
Works.Content2: This site is my second work for the customer, I made a cafe menu on the web page for the convenience of customers. Thus, when the client came to the establishment, the client could scan the QR code to go to the site and view the menu and choose the desired drink from the list, where you can see exactly what the drink the client chose will look like. The site was simplified as much as possible so that the client could understand everything from the first seconds, and the light and dark theme was convenient for those who like bright or dark themes on their phones. The site is designed more for smartphones, but there is also adaptation for desktops.
Works.Content3: My first website was for a customer who asked me to create a visual page for him that looked like the Counter-Strike 2 game. This site has no purpose and no functionality, because this site was made as a demo version of the site that the customer could use in his project, change it, improve it, and add something of his own.
